articles.title: The Binding of Isaac Dev Removes Undisclosed AI-Generated Music From Repentance+ Following Creator Response, Review-Bombing
articles.summary: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis has removed undisclosed AI-generated music included in Repentance+ after backlash led to a review-bombing campaign on Steam and a response from the game's creator, Edmund McMillen.
body: McMillen and Nicalis spent months building up to the November 19, 2026, release date for the latest update in their classic action roguelike game, but that launch was quickly soured. Just 8% of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'s recent Steam reviews are positive, with a good chunk of comments left by players referencing AI-generated material that was not previously mentioned in any official capacity.
"Thanks, Nicalis, for breaking everything and adding AI slop to an already-existing game!" one popular review said.

"I'm starting to think that adding AI to a game should be valid grounds to refunds to people who have already paid for and played a game," another said. "Shameful they would do this to an Indie gem. Shameful."

The allegedly AI-generated content in question seems to be music exclusively tied to a specific, Grand Theft Auto-themed run meant to coincide with the recent release of GTA 6. What could have been a cute jab at another gaming titan boiled into a full-blown controversy for Nicalis when Reddit user ShweetsStuff reported the questionable tunes just one day after launch.

articles.title: The Ecovacs Deebot T90 Pro Omni Robot Vacuum Delivers Incredible 30,000Pa Suction and More High-End Features for $549 During Black Friday
articles.summary: Who wouldn’t love to have a few chores taken off their hands? This holiday season, give someone you love one of the most useful gifts: a brand-new robot vacuum that will leave floors sparkling.
body: I test a lot of robot vacuums and have used an Ecovacs robot vacuum in my home for years. I absolutely love their reliability, innovative designs, and competitive prices. Even if I haven’t had a chance to try the Deebot T90 Pro Omni just yet, it’s sure to deliver an incredible clean, and honestly, all those high-end features under $600 are pretty unheard of.

One of my biggest issues with robot vacuums is their lack of power to pick up larger, heavier messes, especially on deep-pile carpets and rugs. The 30,000Pa boosted suction power is the highest I’ve seen and will remove more debris than your typical robot vacuum. Noise-reducing tech is built in to help keep things quieter. The roller also extends 0.6 inches beyond the body, letting it reach edges, baseboards, and more.

Mopping shouldn’t disappoint either, thanks in large part to the Ozmo 3.0 roller system. The mop self-cleans while scrubbing floors with continuous pressure rather than just wiping like typical mopping pads. The roller also lifts on carpets and rugs, so you won’t need to deal with nasty wet edges. AI tech even helps the robot vacuum precisely weave around obstacles, including pets, while cleaning.

articles.title: 61 Years Later, Charlie Brown's Greatest Enemy Is Still an Undefeated 'Peanuts' Icon
articles.summary: Like many comics aimed at children, Charles Schulz's Peanuts doesn't have too many actual villains. It has a number of antagonists, such as Lucy Van Pelt, various other kids, or the impersonal cloud of failure that constantly hangs over Charlie Brown's head, but it's rare to see a genuinely…
body: One of Charlie Brown's long-standing hobbies in Peanuts was kite-flying, despite not being very good at it. Whenever he tried it, he invariably got his kite caught in trees and/or himself wrapped up in the kite string. Like every other hobby in Charlie Brown's life, he was devoted to it despite his bad luck.

That hobby eventually introduced Charlie Brown to his nemesis. The Kite-Eating Tree was an otherwise unidentified tree in Charlie Brown's neighborhood that seemed to deliberately grab and eat his kites, to the point where Charlie Brown developed a one-sided rivalry with it.

According to Schulz in the autobiographical collection My Life With Charlie Brown (2010), the inspiration for the Kite-Eating Tree was simply a bit of observational humor. Schulz had noticed that a kite that got stuck in a tree would slowly disappear over the course of several weeks, as wildlife and the elements took their toll. He decided that must've been because the tree was eating the kite, and so the Kite-Eating Tree ended up in Peanuts.
The Kite-Eating Tree was first specifically identified in March 1965, which marked the beginning of a recurring story that would last for the next 30 years.

articles.title: GTA 6 Players Report Crashes on PS5 With Error CE-108255-1
articles.summary: GTA 6 players on PlayStation 5 have reported frequent crashes tied to error code CE-108255-1, and it looks like it's blocking them from progressing through the story while they wait for Sony and Rockstar to send out a fix.
body: Although Rockstar Games spent a decade making its new Grand Theft Auto game, it's no surprise to see the new highest-rated game of all time launching with at least a few hiccups. Some have it worse than others, though, with more than a few reports of crashes affecting PS5 consoles popping up online in the days following GTA 6's launch.

The most common cause seems to be tied to error code CE-108255-1, which, as defined by Sony, simply indicates that "an error occurred with the game/application." It seems that, although the majority of players aren't encountering the issue, those who have haven't been able to find a proper fix. Adding to the trouble is that those who have met these dreaded GTA 6 crashes are getting them pretty frequently, and what's triggering them isn't always clear. There are reports from players on both standard PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles running into these issues, with some even saying that crashes appear to be tied to the story, barring them from making any progress.

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Star Hayley Atwell Teases New Trailer for Monday
articles.summary: Avengers: Doomsday star and Captain Carter actor Hayley Atwell appears to have let it slip that a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer is set to premiere this Monday. The longtime Marvel Cinematic Universe actor volunteered the information to a group of fans following a performance of her new Broadway…
body: "There's a new trailer, I think, dropping on Monday," she said with some hesitation. "Am I allowed to have said that?"

Uncertain or not, MCU enjoyers have been on the edge of their seats waiting for what is expected to be the final trailer as Marvel enters the home stretch to the film's premiere. A few short teasers here and there have helped with the wait, but really, the last full-length trailer actually arrived all the way back in August.

As Doctor Doom's assault on the multiverse looms, we're overdue for another look. That said, it has become increasingly clear that Marvel wants to keep most of the movie's big reveals for those who actually make the trip to theaters to see it. While another trailer likely may not be worthy of a slew of new YouTube reaction videos, it's still sure to have a few goodies to entice viewers to make the trip.

Atwell said that, as far as she knows, the new Doomsday trailer will premiere at some point Monday, November 23, 2026. If, for some reason, Marvel decided to push this alleged trailer back, she was able to report that whatever she saw was "amazing."

articles.title: 8 Must-Play JRPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules
articles.summary: It’s 9:15 on a Wednesday night. The dishes are done. You have about 45 minutes before bed, and you’re a JRPG fan (or you were, when you had more time). JRPGs tend to demand dozens of hours from players — and they can make it very difficult to pause, as some of them will interrupt you with a battle…
body: But there are some games in the genre you can bend to fit your week. These eight JRPGs split their stories into chapters, let you switch off random battles, speed up fights, or save almost anywhere. Even if you press start at 9:20, you can still be in bed by 10.

This game opens with a disaster: the Great Chasm swallows a village, and a shepherd named Tiz is the only survivor. You play as Tiz, who teams up with Agnes, a vestal of the Wind Crystal, to free four elemental crystals that darkness has swallowed. Edea, a defector from the Eternian Sky Knights, and Ringabel, an amnesiac who carries a journal that seems to record future events, join the party along the way.

This remaster explicitly hands you the controls for your schedule. You can set the encounter rate from 50 to 200 percent at any time on the field map, push battle speed to 4x, and let auto-battle repeat your last actions. Turn the dial to match whatever time and energy you happen to have when you’re ready to play.

articles.title: Star Trek Reboot Officially Teased as Crimson Tide Meets Training Day Sci-Fi Thriller
articles.summary: After more than a decade of waiting, it seems we may finally get a new theatrically released Star Trek movie. While dedicated Trekkies have heard that before, the directors of the only known Star Trek movie in development recently shared details about their project.
body: Specifically, they cited Training Day and Crimson Tide as jumping-off points for what they’re going for.

For those unfamiliar with Training Day, it stars Ethan Hawke as a newcomer LAPD narcotics officer under the tutelage of the corrupt detective Alonzo Harris, played by Denzel Washington. As for Crimson Tide, it’s a thriller about a U.S. nuclear submarine facing off against a Russian ultranationalist faction threatening to launch nukes at the U.S. and Japan (interestingly enough, it also stars Washington).

Past Star Trek movies have dealt with Starfleet bad apples before to varying levels of success, including Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country, Star Trek: Insurrection, and Star Trek Into Darkness. But Daly and Goldstein have another twist on the Star Trek formula.
“It takes place almost in real time, and it just is a whole other look at what a Star Trek movie could be without betraying the fundamentals of what it should be,” Daley said.

articles.title: Astarion's Baldur's Gate 3 prequel novel infuriated fans, now it's Shadowheart's turn
articles.summary: Tasha Suri, author of the Burning Kingdoms trilogy and several other books, will be writing Baldur's Gate 3: Shadowheart, the official BG3books website has announced. Another prequel to Larian's videogame, this one focuses on Shadowheart's time as a priestess in the Church of Shar, and is about a…
body: "When a member of their order is killed in the Upper City," the blurb goes, "Shadowheart and her so-called allies are called to investigate. She trusts none of them: not Mirie, the ambitious Griefguard; not Caldan, the cynical propagandist; and certainly not Nocturne, the charming quartermistress, who claims to have only Shadowheart’s best interests in mind."

Mirie and Nocturne are both characters you can meet in Baldur's Gate 3, while Caldan Darkwood is mentioned in a note you can find. Nocturne in particular has a close relationship with Shadowheart, which could be interesting to see developed. "Torn between the familiar comforts of the dark and the thrill of new desire," the blurb continues, "she must solve the mystery to prove her devotion… or be cast into the light."

Which sounds fine and dandy, but it'll have an uphill battle with the Baldur's Gate 3 fandom, who've been vocally critical of the Astarion novel for its lightness of tone—especially given his traumatic backstory—and apparently mischaracterizing Astarion and his sire, Cazador, as well as being inaccurate to the lore.

articles.title: Star Wars' New Jedi Order Era is Officially Moving Forward
articles.summary: Despite Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu struggling at the box office, it seems Disney is continuing development on two upcoming Star Wars films. This summer, Star Wars: New Jedi Order and Dave Filoni’s untitled movie as in-development projects were confirmed to be in the works in industry…
body: Star Wars: New Jedi Order will reportedly bring back Daisy Ridley as Rey (Skywalker) roughly 15 years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker as she rebuilds the Jedi. Considering that the Star Wars fandom has largely negative feelings about the sequel trilogy, especially after The Rise of Skywalker, New Jedi Order ’s direct ties to that film will pose a steep challenge.

The project has cycled through several writers. Damon Lindelof ( Lost, The Leftovers, Watchmen ) and Justin Britt-Gibson were the original screenwriters before Disney fired them — the pair are currently working together on HBO’s superhero detective series, Lanterns. Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight was also set to write, but left the project in 2024. Last January, Variety reported that George Nolfi ( The Bourne Ultimatum ) is now writing the script. Filmmaker Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy is set to direct the film. New Jedi Order was originally scheduled for release on Dec. 17, 2027, but was removed from Disney’s schedule in May 2025.

articles.title: Comcast: 'At peak, GTA 6 accounted for nearly a quarter of all internet traffic'
articles.summary: In a post to X, "The Everything App," US entertainment and communications conglomerate Comcast revealed that Grand Theft Auto 6's historic launch drove record-breaking internet traffic.
body: "GTA 6 didn't just break records in gaming," Comcast wrote. "Its launch drove the biggest internet traffic day in our network history, with traffic climbing 31% above an average day. At peak, GTA 6 accounted for nearly a quarter of all network traffic."

Comcast shared a video of a line graph showing the massive relative spike in activity on November 19. The chart is unlabeled except for the date, but it presumably corresponds to the volume of data being downloaded across Comcast's entire network.

And that last but does add a caveat to the numbers Comcast cited: Its network and "the entire internet" are two different things, unless I'm missing something here or Comcast's data accounts for other ISPs and other countries, not just its own services.

Regardless, it's still a significant bit of fun with statistics, another example of the totalizing footprint of what may be the largest commercial launch in entertainment history. Imagine how much bigger it would have been launching on PC as well.
points: In a post to X, "The Everything App," US entertainment and communications conglomerate Comcast revealed that Grand Theft Auto 6's historic launch drove record-breaking internet traffic.

articles.title: The team behind Ubisoft's 'first playable AI-based R&D project' has been established as its own subsidiary called Motherbrain
articles.summary: Use of generative AI in game dev remains as contentious as it does ubiquitous— a recent GDC report found that around 40% of devs use AI, but more than half think its influence has been negative.
body: As reported by VGC, Motherbrain's purpose is to develop "AI for gameplay innovation, supporting all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences … Its current focus is on new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory and AI game masters that manage large scale systemic worlds," according to an earnings report which was released Thursday.

The information comes at a turbulent time for the publishing giant, which just laid off 166 employees even after Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced "outperformed expectations." A sweeping internal overhaul earlier this year saw the company reorganize its workforce into a throng of "creative houses," a decision which led to swathes of layoffs and six project cancellations, including the Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake.

It's not clear what Motherbrain are at work on, in specific terms, right now, but there may be some clues in its past work. That playable AI "experience" I mentioned earlier is none other than Teammates, an R&D project based on a prior experiment with uncanny AI "neo-NPCs."

articles.title: Phasmophobia's next update lets you ask ghosts to throw things and it's out next week
articles.summary: Phasmophobia 's next update, Resonance, arrives on 24th November, bringing a brand-new piece of ghost-hunting kit, more voice commands, and a move to the Unity 6 engine.
body: The headline addition is dowsing rods, which will help you track down the bone, making them particularly handy on bigger maps like Brownstone High School. As with the rest of the game's equipment, the higher the Tier, the more accurate the reading, and Tier 3 Dowsing Rods will pinpoint the exact floor the Bone is on.

The Sound Sensor is getting an overhaul too, with a reworked interface to help you work out where sounds are coming from. Icons will show whether a sound is ongoing or a one-off, and you'll be able to use the map to identify ghosts by how fast they move.

You'll also be able to ask ghosts to interact with doors and switches, and even throw nearby objects, with a list of usable phrases in the Journal. If you're tired of the same maps, you'll be able to build your own pool of maps to randomise from when picking a contract, and new buttons let you quickly pick small, medium, or large maps.
"We want to ensure every item in our Ghost Hunters' kits can add as much value as possible in investigations," said Daniel Knight, CEO and game director at Kinetic Games.

articles.title: GTA 6 Protective Custody: Should you choose proceed or postpone when you go to meet Abe?
articles.summary: Deciding whether to proceed or postpone the Protective Custody story mission is a big choice you'll need to make in GTA 6. The mission appears on your map as "Meet Abe" in Chapter 5, once you've completed the mission Operation Savage Glory.
body: Once you get to Abe's office, Jason will warn Lucia that everything will change after this mission. Lucia will hesitate at the door as you make your choice to "Proceed" or "Postpone."

This is a pretty big decision, because Protective Custody kicks off the final mission of the game which takes about an hour to play. And even though it's a binary choice between "Proceed" (which starts the mission) and "Postpone" (which delays the mission)" there's actually a third possible outcome based on when you make the choice.

It's a long mission that will take about an hour to play, so be prepared. You can't save during this mission so make sure you've got the time! Once you've completed the final mission, you can watch the credits and return to the open world so you can continue playing.
You will go back to the open world to continue playing. The "Meet Abe" icon will remain on your map so you can begin the final mission at any point from then on.

articles.title: GTA 6 is crashing on some PS5s with error CE-108255-1 - here's what you can try
articles.summary: Some Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PS5 say the game keeps crashing with error code CE-108255-1, and in some cases, it's stopping them from progressing through the story.
body: "The game runs perfectly fine for a while. I can complete missions and chapters without any issues, but then it suddenly crashes after around 40 minutes and sends me back to the PS5 home screen", wrote one Reddit user. They added that other games, including GTA 5 and For Honor, run without crashing.

Another player told Dexerto that GTA 6 worked fine until Pipework, an early mission that introduces Mandy, but now crashes "every time I use the plunger or stand around the sink with it", which means they can’t progress.
Some PS5 Pro owners say the game crashes during the opening prologue, either at the same point every time or a few seconds in, and they haven't been able to play since launch.

Others say they've tried the usual fixes, such as clearing their console's cache, rebuilding the database, factory resetting their PS5, and even downloading the game three times, but nothing has worked thus far.

articles.title: Unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has been rated in Korea
articles.summary: A rating for the unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has popped up on Korea's Game Rating and Administration Committee ( GRAC ).
body: As Insider Gaming spotted, the board gave Nioh 3 Complete Edition a 19+ rating on 17th November after it was submitted on 2nd November, even though Koei Tecmo hasn't announced a Complete Edition for the game yet.

The listing, translated by machine, describes it as "a compilation of additional content from the dark Sengoku action RPG Nioh 3", and gives the rating for "excessive expression of violence", noting that "red blood and body amputation frequently occur during combat".
The listing also notes an overseas rating, which Insider Gaming says is a 17+ rating from Japan's CERO.
Unlike some rating boards, GRAC publishes its ratings as soon as they're decided, which is why game listings often surface there before they're officially announced.
